title: 1 Year Ago, Shonen Jump’s Most Underrated Fantasy Series Was Cancelled
content: Shueisha’s Shonen Jump went through a major change in 2025 with a wave of manga endings. Whether it’s the series reaching its natural conclusion or getting unofficially axed, the platform ended dozens of series last year.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Up! Global Adds 'If Witch, Then Which?' Manga
content: The company describes the story: Ever since a lifesaving blood transfusion, Haruka Kuze has been indebted to Maruna Rinjou. The only problem: How do you show your gratitude to someone who barely gives you the time of day?
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Officially Announces Massive New Theme Park
content: Dragon Ball has officially announced there’s a massive new theme park now in development as part of a huge $7 billion USD deal to help make it happen. As Dragon Ball continues to celebrate the milestone 40th anniversary of Akira Toriyama’s original manga series making its first debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump…
author: ComicBook

title: Cartoon Network Classic Series Receiving The Release They Deserve This Fall
content: Physical media has had a tough time in recent years, as the move to digital/streaming platforms is something that cannot be denied. With Blu-Rays, DVDs, and 4K discs becoming more sparse, many fans are still looking to get their hands on full sets for some of their favorite shows.
author: ComicBook

title: Matsuken Anime Reveals Ken Matsudaira, Sumire Uesaka as Main Cast Members, August 29 Debut
content: Tatsunoko Production announced on Tuesday that the short anime project Matsuken Anime , based on Japanese actor and singer Ken Matsudaira 's 'Matsuken Samba" songs, will debut on August 29 on YouTube with the full title Matsuken Anime ~Kore Seibaishite mo Ii desu ka?~ ( Matsuken Anime ~Can I Pass Judgment on This?~).
author: ANN

title: Magic Repo Man Anime Unveils New Cast Member, October 4 Debut
content: TV Asahi unveiled the key visual, additional cast member, and October 4 premiere for the television anime of Masakichi and Shingou Iijima 's Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
author: ANN

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 14 Preview Trailer and Images Revealed
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 14 (Episode 80 overall) preview ahead of its August 26, 2026 premiere. This will be the third episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand Anime Casts Ami Koshimizu
content: The staff for the television anime of Ezogingitune and illustrator DeeCHA 's I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand ( Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Series Casts Hayate Ichinose
content: NHK announced on Tuesday that the live-action series of Yūki Kodama 's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga has cast Hayate Ichinose ( Kishiryū Sentai Ryusoulger ) as the male lead Tatsuki Manabe. The series will premiere on NHK 's "Yorudora" programming block this fall.
author: ANN

title: Quintet's Terranigma RPG Gets Release in 2027
content: Publisher Clear River Games announced on Monday that it will release Quintet's 1995 RPG Terranigma on Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and GOG in 2027. Clear River Games describes the game: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay.
author: ANN
